name: Cloudgate Jobs
description: Service requests, quotes, scheduled job visits, invoices and customer payments with a shared Cloudgate React back office.
features: Responsive public business website, authenticated customer portal and separate back office
Customer requests and service addresses, versioned quotes, optional extras, discounts, configurable tax and online approval
Job visits with multiple staff assignments, schedule conflict protection, availability blocks, checklists, notes and time tracking
Deposits and final balances through native Cloudgate Wallet workflows, verified payment state and durable refund requests
Downloadable quote, invoice and payment-receipt PDFs, operational reports and CSV export
Private request and job photos with record-level access checks and staff-controlled visibility
Recurring job generation, reminder outbox and scheduled payment, refund and email workers
Owner, office and assigned-technician access, customer ownership and activity history
Shared Cloudgate React SDK for authentication, profile, users, roles, media, branding, themes, analytics, logs and developer tools
